title: How, Exactly, Could A.I. Kill Us?
summary: This New Yorker Q&A article explores the theoretical pathways through which advanced artificial intelligence could pose existential risks to humanity, featuring expert analysis on AI alignment and catastrophic scenarios.
problem_solved: Addresses public concern and misunderstanding about how AI systems could potentially cause catastrophic or existential harm to humanity.
why_valuable: Provides credible, expert-informed perspective on a critically important but often sensationalized topic, helping readers understand genuine AI risks versus science fiction scenarios.
